question: If X=((1+cos theta)(2-2cos theta))/((2+2sin theta)(1-sin theta)), then the value of X+(1)/(X) + 2 is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 45°** in the given expression.

X = [(1 + 1/√2)(2 − 2/√2)] / [(2 + 2/√2)(1 − 1/√2)] = [2(1 − 1/2)] / [2(1 − 1/2)] = 1.

Then X + 1/X + 2 = 1 + 1 + 2 = 4.

Check options at θ = 45°: Option (4) cosec² 45° sec² 45° = (√2)² × (√2)² = 2 × 2 = 4.

**∴ The correct answer is cosec² θ sec² θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ce1e2e97dfd80ba1f64921ae274935e56c96ecc0481872ce0f16b18e5d7177b.png] 

Given: X = [(1 + cos θ) × 2(1 − cos θ)] / [2(1 + sin θ) × (1 − sin θ)]

⇒ X = [2(1 − cos² θ)] / [2(1 − sin² θ)]

⇒ X = sin² θ / cos² θ = tan² θ

Now, calculate X + 1/X + 2:

⇒ tan² θ + cot² θ + 2

⇒ (tan θ + cot θ)²

⇒ (sin θ / cos θ + cos θ / sin θ)²

⇒ [(sin² θ + cos² θ) / (sin θ cos θ)]²

⇒ [1 / (sin θ cos θ)]² = 1 / (sin² θ cos² θ) = cosec² θ sec² θ

**∴ The correct answer is cosec² θ sec² θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Basic identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, and cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

Reciprocal Relations

sec θ = 1/cos θ, cosec θ = 1/sin θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ.

Identity for sec²θ + cosec²θ

The sum sec²θ + cosec²θ is always equal to their product sec²θ × cosec²θ.</p
